title: 第24章 被人拿枪指着
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“诶诶诶，师姐你干嘛！怎么跑出来了，东西拿到了吗？”

    林曦不说话，只是低着头往外走，脚步快得像在逃命。

    “师姐！师姐你慢点～”

    门砰的一声关上。

    陆沉坐在床上，长长地吐了一口气。

    他低头看了看自己的手，手指上还残留着她的体香。

    “……我是不是有点过分了？”

    没人回答他。

    隔壁房间。

    魅姬：“什么？他跟你说了什么？你脸红成这样……师姐你别走啊！”

    然后是更远的一扇门关上的声音。

    很显然，林曦什么也不想和魅姬解释。

    ……

    第二天一早，陆沉就收拾好了东西，准备麻溜儿的滚蛋，离开这是非之地。

    林天本来还想多玩几天，但是架不住陆沉和王峰的催促，只好和他们一起回去。

    只是，当众人都准备启程的时候，魅姬还是过来了。

    “林郎，这就走啦？”

    陆沉回过头，直接贼心不死的魅姬倚在门框上，一身紫裙松松垮垮地裹着身子，长发披散着，一副俏皮佳人的模样。

    “是啊，我们都还有事，你好好照顾自己，过段时间我再来看你。”

    “可是，我还有事要和林郎商量，你看……”魅姬说着，不经意间对着陆沉比划了一下。

    其意思不言而喻。

    陆沉麻了。

    “既然小嫂子和师兄还有事，那我就陪着，和师兄一起回去！”他立马表态。

    “我就不多待了，在这里纯浪费时间，不如回去炼几炉丹。”王峰摆手。

    “那行，王峰师兄，你那个悬赏令，我让师姐帮帮你。她在魔门认识的人多，核心追求者也多，说不定能查到什么。”

    王峰一怔，犹豫了一下。

    “那就有劳了。”

    “不客气。”

    魅姬笑盈盈的，只是她的目光看的人却是陆沉。

    王峰御剑离去，转眼就不见了踪影。

    林天正要开口问魅姬何事，后者却引导他去了其他地方，让陆沉在房间里等。

    她的意思很明显。

    自己不给她那个，是跑不掉的。

    果不其然，林天没走多久，林曦就出现在了门口。
content_en:
"Hey, senior sister, what are you doing! Why did you run out? Did you get the things?"

Lin Xi didn't say anything, just lowered her head and walked out, walking as fast as she was running for her life.

"Senior sister! Senior sister, please slow down~"

The door slammed shut.

Lu Chen sat on the bed and took a long breath.

He looked down at his hands, her body fragrance still lingering on his fingers.

"...Am I going a little too far?"

No one answered him.

Next door room.

Mei Ji: "What? What did he say to you? You are blushing like this... Senior sister, please don't leave!"

Then there was the sound of a door closing further away.

Obviously, Lin Xi didn't want to explain anything to Mei Ji.

…

Early the next morning, Lu Chen packed his things and prepared to get out of here and leave this place of trouble.

Lin Tian originally wanted to play for a few more days, but couldn't resist the urging of Lu Chen and Wang Feng, so he had to go back with them.

However, when everyone was preparing to set off, Mei Ji came over.

"Lin Lang, are you leaving now?"

Lu Chen turned around and saw the evil-minded Mei Ji leaning against the door frame, wearing a purple skirt loosely wrapped around her body, her long hair hanging loose, looking like a playful beauty.

"Yeah, we all have things to do. You take good care of yourself. I'll come see you again after a while."

"But, I still have something to discuss with Lin Lang. Look..." Mei Ji said, inadvertently gesticulating to Lu Chen.

The meaning is self-evident.

Lu Chen was numb.

"Since my sister-in-law and senior brother still have something to do, I will accompany you and go back with senior brother!" He immediately expressed his position.

"I won't stay any longer. It's just a waste of time here. Why not go back and refine a few furnaces of pills." Wang Feng waved his hand.

"Okay, Senior Brother Wang Feng, I will ask Senior Sister to help you with your reward order. She knows many people in the Demon Sect and has many core suitors. Maybe she can find something."

Wang Feng was startled and hesitated.

"Then it'll be hard work."

"You're welcome."

Mei Ji was smiling, but the person she was looking at was Lu Chen.

Wang Feng left with his sword and disappeared in a blink of an eye.

Lin Tian was about to ask Mei Ji what was going on, but the latter guided him to another place and asked Lu Chen to wait in the room.

Her meaning was obvious.

If you don't give her that, you can't run away.

Sure enough, not long after Lin Tian left, Lin Xi appeared at the door.
